'''2011 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Mike Richards LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2011 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused|Theed-L-wehaveaplan.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Michael Richards
* '''Deck name:''' (@Y@)
* '''Username:''' mrdet7agent
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
